title: Father of Me and All Mankind
description: Father of Me and All Mankind in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 491 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"Thy Kingdom Come."”, where the book credits them to Wesley's Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Fa-ther of me and all man-kind, And all the hosts a-bove, Let ev-ery un-der-stand-ing mind U-nite to praise thy love.

lines: Father of me and all mankind,
Thy kingdom come, with power and grace
Thy peace, and joy, and righteousness,
But makes an end of sin;
The joy that human thought transcends,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
